::: {#def-rejection-counts}
#### Outcome counts of a family of tests

Suppose a procedure tests $m$ null hypotheses, $m_0$ of which are true.
Count the outcomes as in @tbl-rejection-counts:
$V$ true null hypotheses rejected (false positives),
$S$ false null hypotheses rejected (true positives),
$U$ true null hypotheses not rejected,
and $T$ false null hypotheses not rejected.
The total number of **rejections** is

$$R \eqdef V + S.$$

| | Not rejected | Rejected | Total |
|:--------------------|:-----:|:-----:|:-------------:|
| Null hypothesis true | $U$ | $V$ | $m_0$ |
| Null hypothesis false | $T$ | $S$ | $m - m_0$ |
| Total | $m - R$ | $R$ | $m$ |

: Outcomes of $m$ tests, of which $m_0$ have a true null hypothesis. {#tbl-rejection-counts}

:::
